relevance.justification: GTO is a gene-centric database linking clinical trials to genes (HGNC symbols, 614 altered genes), diseases (DOID, MONDO, MeSH IDs), therapy types, vectors, and GEO transcriptome accessions. Core entities map cleanly to BioThings: genes (HGNC) and diseases (MONDO/DOID). The clinical trial dimension (NCT IDs, phases, outcomes, adverse events) and gene therapy vector/construct metadata are novel for BioThings. Score capped at 4 (not 5) because the omics data (40+ GB expression profiles) is too large to ingest and the clinical trial records are the primary unit of value, not genes themselves.

novelty.justification: No existing BioThings API covers gene therapy clinical trial data. MyGene.info has gene annotations but no clinical trial linkage. MyDisease.info has disease annotations but no gene-therapy treatment context. pending.api sources do not include gene therapy trial records. GTO's combination of: (1) clinical trial IDs + phase/status/outcome, (2) therapy type/vector/construct detail, (3) GEO-linked transcriptome datasets per trial, and (4) disease MONDO/DOID cross-references is entirely absent from current BioThings ecosystem. This is a fully novel data type.

openness.justification: Homepage states explicitly: 'This website is open and free for all users with no login required.' All four Excel download files (clinical detail, clinical basic, omics metadata, indication/disease) download without authentication. README states 'for academic and research purposes only' with no formal license specified (no CC, no proprietary restriction stated). All download URLs return 200 OK with Content-Disposition headers confirming direct file access.
